name: pool-maintenance
//: The budget on this repository's declared pool maintenance (onevcs.toml, the justfile's pool-maintenance recipe): budgets.yaml and the measurement it runs, measure.sh, which builds the workspace twice. So its budget check is `budgets-release`, a name no per-change selection runs — neither `just check` nor the `budgets` recipe's `budgets`/`budgets-host` — and only the release pull request's CI job runs it, after the gate. The gate reaches only its shell format and lint targets.
